_metadata.title: AyushIntake Clinical Lab Reference Ranges & Mismatch Rules
_metadata.disclaimer: CLINICAL REVIEW REQUIRED: These thresholds are reference ranges for flagging discrepancies between patient self-reports and uploaded documentation. The system NEVER makes a diagnosis from these values; it only prompts the doctor to check conflicting data.
_metadata.mismatch_message_template: Check: patient answer differs from report ({field}: reported '{patient_value}', report indicates '{report_value}')

fasting_blood_glucose.mismatch_rule: IF patient denies diabetes AND extracted_value >= 126 THEN flag_mismatch

post_prandial_blood_glucose.mismatch_rule: IF patient denies diabetes AND extracted_value >= 200 THEN flag_mismatch

hba1c.mismatch_rule: IF patient denies diabetes AND extracted_value >= 6.5 THEN flag_mismatch

systolic_bp.mismatch_rule: IF patient denies hypertension AND extracted_value >= 140 THEN flag_mismatch

serum_creatinine.mismatch_rule: IF patient denies kidney issues AND extracted_value >= 1.4 THEN flag_mismatch

hemoglobin.mismatch_rule: IF patient denies anemia AND extracted_value < 10.0 THEN flag_mismatch
